children.innerHTML: Changelog
Every release, honestly annotated. Breaking changes get a siren, not a footnote.
FEATURE
Remote caching is out of beta. Median team saves 41 CI-minutes per day.
hex --why now explains cache misses across machines, not just your own.
New: hex migrate --from=turbo, tested on 200 public repos.
FIX
Fixed a race where two watchers could both claim the daemon socket.
Windows path handling: apologies to the three of you, it's fixed.
BREAKING
Config renamed hex.config.ts (was buildfile.ts). hex migrate rewrites it for you.
Node 18 dropped. It was time.
Cache format v3: first build after upgrade is cold. Once.
FEATURE
Watch mode rebuilds in-memory: median save-to-done now 400ms.
Terminal output learned to be quiet when everything works.
